messages:
incident-bot: CRITICAL: GPU node pool 'inference-prod' at max capacity (12/12). Autoscaler reported "quota_exceeded". Pending queue: ~6200 requests, 95% tail latency rising. Paging infra-oncall.
Leah: saw the page, on it. any immediate mitigation knobs?
Rajat: looks like node group hit provider max size, autoscaler kept retrying and failing. Container logs show Pending scheduling due to node shortage.
Leah: copying commands I'm about to run. will try manual capacity bump via capctl if approved.
Leah: @Maya can you approve a manual increase +4 nodes for inference-prod? this is customer-impacting (429s seen). :warning:
Maya: approve — go ahead. escalate to ops so they know billing may change. keep me posted.
Devon: FYI CS spotted errors for AcmeCorp and LambdaFin. CS-ops, do you have a quick impact summary?
CS-ops: AcmeCorp reported 50% requests failing with 504/429 over last 8m. SLA alerts firing. We're contacting their on-call.
Rajat: running capctl now. command:```bash
capctl request --pool inference-prod --delta 4 --reason "prod autoscale ceiling hit; manual bump for live incident"
```
capctl-bot: Request submitted (req-8732). Notifying cloud-provider team. Estimated provisioning 6-12m.
Leah: while we wait, enabling fallback routing to smaller model family for non-enterprise customers. patching policy:```yaml
route:
  - match: 
      priority: non-enterprise
    model: small-gen-v1
    ttl: 300
```
Rajat: also evicting low-priority batch pods to free up preemptible capacity. `kubectl drain` + taints on batch queue.
Devon: can we reduce batch concurrency for 15m to lower pressure?
Leah: done. lowered batch parallelism to 1 for affected jobs.
capctl-bot: Cloud provider accepted request req-8732, scaling group update in progress.
incident-bot: NOTE: created incident ticket INC-2026-314 (priority P1). Paging SRE rotation.
Maya: thanks. Leah please post ETA when nodes are up and confirm reduced queue.
Leah: capctl-bot just updated: instances provisioning. ETA 9m.
Rajat: once nodes join, I'll uncordon and let pending pods schedule. planning a graceful churn to avoid KV cache thrash.
Leah: partial relief spotted — queue dropped from 6200 -> 2800 after evictions and fallback routes. tail latency still elevated but improving.
capctl-bot: Instances joined (3/4). final instance provisioning 1m.
Leah: final node joined. verifying pods scheduling...
Rajat: pods coming up, starting warm-up. running `kubectl get pods -n inference-prod` — most pending -> Running.
Leah: queue down to ~400. 429s falling back to baseline.
CS-ops: AcmeCorp confirms errors cleared. PR for customer comms drafted.
Maya: great work. please keep monitoring for 30m and file a follow-up postmortem with root cause (policy vs cloud quota vs autoscaler bug).
Leah: handing off monitoring to Rajat for the night shift. I'll update incident ticket and attach logs.
Rajat: taking over. I'll keep an eye on autoscaler events and set alert thresholds higher temporarily.
incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Postmortem required.
Leah: filed incident summary, attaching steps: capctl request, evict low-priority batches, fallback routing, reduced batch concurrency. Will include timestamps and command outputs in the postmortem.
Devon: note: recommend adding an automated fallback policy when pool usage >90% to shift non-critical traffic to small-gen models.
Maya: +1 on fallback automation. also let's review nodeGroup max size limits and quota requests during follow-up.
Leah: thanks everyone, closing the live thread. will ping when postmortem draft is ready. :thumbsup:
